features.name: Agent Mode
features.description: Multi-step operation mode for agents that can handle complex workflows from simple operations to multi-day sessions with extended reasoning and tool usage.

features.name: Ask Mode
features.description: Simple chat mode for simple question and answer interactions that do not extend over long periods.

features.name: Plan Mode
features.description: Mode for research and planning where the agent gathers information and creates a plan before execution.

features.name: Custom Agents
features.description: User-defined agents specified in markdown files with front matter containing name, description, tools, skills, knowledge, and system prompt.

features.name: Skills
features.description: Reusable workflow definitions or prompts that capture a set of steps for agents to execute. They are loaded on demand and do not consume context window space initially.
caveats: Skills are loaded on demand

features.name: BC Quality Repository Skills
features.description: GitHub repository where skills and knowledge for agents are captured and shared, including contributions from Microsoft and the community.

features.name: Agent Tools
features.description: Tools enable agents to modify and interact with their environments through discovery and reasoning. Agents analyze tasks, decide which tools to call, receive results, and continue reasoning in the agentic loop.

features.name: Language Model Tools API
features.description: API mechanism specific to Visual Studio Code that exposes tools for coding agents out of the box.

features.name: MCP Servers for AL Development
features.description: Model Context Protocol servers providing tools for AL development, including troubleshooting tools available during debugging sessions.
caveats: Troubleshooting tools only available during debugging

features.name: Build Tool
features.description: Agent tool for building AL applications. Can build a specific app, a graph of apps, or all apps in the workspace.

features.name: Symbol and Relationship Tools
features.description: Tools that expose symbols and relationships between them, allowing agents to query code before taking action to find efficient solutions.

features.name: Publishing and Debugging Tools
features.description: Tools for publishing AL apps and debugging applications during development.

features.name: Test Tools
features.description: Tools for testing AL applications that integrate with Visual Studio Code's test runner.
caveats: Integrate with Visual Studio Code test runner

features.name: Troubleshooting Tools
features.description: MCP server-based tools available during debugging sessions for investigating issues, accessing source code, stack frames, variables, and database statistics.
caveats: Only available during debugging sessions

features.name: Tool Discovery and Invocation
features.description: Agents discover tools and automatically decide which ones to call based on task descriptions. Users can also reference tools directly in chat.

features.name: Approval Workflow
features.description: Configuration for agent tool execution with options for varying levels of autonomy including bypass approval for automatic tool execution.
caveats: Requires trust in available tools and consideration of security versus autonomy

features.name: Context Size Configuration
features.description: Agent configuration allowing users to define context size, enabling agents to accumulate more information before compacting or summarizing context.

features.name: Reasoning Model Selection
features.description: Agent configuration allowing selection of reasoning model and type for different problem-solving approaches.

features.name: ALMCP Server
features.description: Server exposing AL development tools as MCP protocol endpoints, available as a .NET tool installable via NuGet. Covers scenarios beyond Visual Studio Code including CLI usage and includes extra tools for authentication and running tests.
caveats: available as pre-release flag for latest features

features.name: AL CLI Tool
features.description: A .NET tool installable via NuGet that provides AL command access everywhere once imported. Can be used to compile apps, query information, and launch the MCP server for AL. Also used to call the AL compiler (ALC).
caveats: pre-release flag available for latest features

features.name: Agent database statistics access
features.description: The agent has access to all database statistics and SQL statements for investigating performance issues and inefficient patterns in code.

features.name: Agent stack trace analysis
features.description: Agent can call get stack frames and get variables to analyze code execution and identify issues like whitespace problems that need fixing with methods like trim.

features.name: ALMCP GitHub Copilot integration
features.description: ALMCP server can be registered and configured in GitHub Copilot to enable agents to discover and use AL tools including project management, authentication, compilation, and symbol handling.
caveats: agent may discover AL tool and try using ALC directly, requiring instructions to redirect to ALMCP

features.name: Language Server Protocol (LSP) for AL
features.description: LSP provides agents with in-depth semantic understanding of AL language development through endpoints like go to definition, find references, formatting, and renaming. Introduced by Visual Studio Code team in 2016.
caveats: LSP provides subset of commands compared to full AL tools
requires package cache path configuration

features.name: LSP folding range endpoint
features.description: LSP endpoint that enables folding of code sections such as layout sections in pages, allowing agents to scope their analysis to specific regions rather than searching all code.

features.name: BCbench evaluation framework
features.description: Evaluation framework based on SWE bench that contains real bugs from actual commits to verify coding agents don't cause regressions. Uses hidden tests for verification of bug fixes.
caveats: based on real commits that must contain both fix and test
runs evaluation five times due to LLM nondeterminism

features.name: Hidden test verification method
features.description: BCbench uses hidden tests from actual commits to verify agent-generated fixes. Tests are run against agent-generated code after time-traveling to before the original commit, ensuring agent knowledge of neither fix nor test.
caveats: requires commits with both fix and test
nondeterministic results require five runs averaged

features.name: Agentic workflow framework
features.description: A sequence of steps calling tools, instructions and skills toward a purpose. The framework emphasizes reusability, consistency, token efficiency, composability and portability of skills across workflows.

features.name: RAL loop technique
features.description: A technique for agentic task execution with specified success criteria. The agent verifies criteria, and if not met, restarts the loop with additional changes. Supports configurable maximum attempts to enable recovery without immediate failure.
caveats: Requires specification of success criteria per task

features.name: BC fix skill
features.description: A workflow skill for bug fixing that guides the agent through planning, test creation, and fix implementation. Contains sub-skills for different workflow phases and supports entry points for direct plan input or interactive planning mode.
caveats: Complexity arises from reusable sub-skills shared across workflows
Context rot mitigation requires sub-agents to avoid exploding context

features.name: BC fix baseline skill
features.description: A sub-skill within BC fix workflow that creates failing test cases to reproduce bug conditions. Uses RAL loop with success criteria requiring tests to fail according to actual error in GitHub issue, not random failures.
caveats: Requires accurate error matching from GitHub issues
Can iterate up to maximum attempts

features.name: BC fix implement skill
features.description: A sub-skill for implementing bug fixes and verifying through test passage. Runs as separate sub-agent to avoid context rot, applies fixes iteratively until tests pass using TDD pattern.
caveats: Runs on Claude Sonnet 4.6 for cost efficiency
Requires test suite to validate fixes

features.name: BC test implement agent
features.description: A standalone general-purpose agent that implements test coverage for features. Can be used independently or injected into BC fix workflow. Supports test automation without specific workflow dependencies.

features.name: AL developer session skill (BCLdev session)
features.description: A workflow skill that reads GitHub issue context, sets up the development environment, and orchestrates sub-skills for the bug fixing workflow. Serves as the main orchestrator for the BC fix workflow.

features.name: MCP tools integration
features.description: Integration of MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools with AL development workflows. Enables agents to access LSP (Language Server Protocol), build, test, and publish capabilities through MCP server tooling.
caveats: Requires MCP server configuration with launch parameters

features.name: Agent evaluation methodology
features.description: Approach to validate agent-generated code using hidden test suites. Evaluates single variables iteratively against baseline model, tools, and instructions. Runs multiple iterations to account for LLM nondeterminism and averages results.
caveats: LLM nondeterminism requires multiple runs (e.g., five iterations)
Cannot verify correctness through LLM alone
Requires separate test infrastructure

features.name: Sub-agent context isolation
features.description: Technique to run specialized agents in isolated sessions to avoid context rot. Passes only necessary state (plan, test results) to sub-agents rather than full conversation history.
caveats: Requires careful state file management
May use different models for cost optimization

features.name: Session retrospective skill
features.description: A skill for analyzing agent failure modes when bugs cannot be fixed. Summarizes agent attempts and identifies what was tried and what remains to try, reducing manual review of all attempts.
caveats: Does not check all possible attempts due to time constraints
May still fail on complex problems

features.name: Business Central performance profile tool
features.description: A tool for implementing tests that run on large data sets and enabling profiler to identify long-running SQL queries and performance issues.
caveats: Profiler reading by agents is not yet implemented in workflows
Performance evaluation recommended before production

features.name: Agent-assisted telemetry analysis
features.description: Ability to run multiple concurrent sessions and feed telemetry logs to agents to analyze performance issues and identify problematic code lines.
caveats: Post-production analysis only in current workflow
Requires human interpretation before implementation

features.name: Agent pull request commenting
features.description: Agent automatically adds comments to pull requests based on code review categories such as bug fixing and test coverage. Agent can assess comment relevance.
caveats: Human review still required for pull request approval
Additional loop needed to handle pipeline gate failures

features.name: Custom AL code analyzers with MCP server
features.description: Configure code analyzers on the LSP connection which will analyze and check the code during project building.
caveats: Requires launching MCP server with specific parameters
